headline: No edge validated under our rules yet. Below: selected documented results and two forward paper tracks.
counters: Real money at risk in these tests
counterNote: Counts follow the reconciled research ledger and were checked against it on 2026-11-06. $0 refers to these research tests and paper tracks only. Historical studies differ in how much was written down in advance and what had already been seen; each record carries its own disclosures. Several hold-out tests were underpowered, so a fail there is weak evidence, not proof that nothing exists.

tracks.name: BTC40 trend filter (paper only)
tracks.rule: Weekly close above the 40-week average: hold Bitcoin. Otherwise cash. Cost 0.25% per switch.
tracks.disclosure: Chosen after seeing backtests of close neighbours (BTC1 and BTC2 both failed the drawdown bar), so this is a forward test of the closest variant, not a clean result. Paper fills at weekly closes do not show what limit orders would achieve.
tracks.verdictRule: Pass only if buy-and-hold's forward drawdown is at least 20% AND this rule's drawdown is at most 60% of it with at least 70% of its return and at least 2 switches. Otherwise inconclusive.

tracks.name: CRY2 Bitcoin / Ether rotation (paper only)
tracks.rule: Hold whichever of Bitcoin or Ether has the better 8-week return, if either is positive. Otherwise cash. Cost 0.25% per leg.
tracks.disclosure: Backtest verdict: provisional pass on its five locked tests. Robustness check: at double the costs the edge falls to about +0.6 points a year, below its own +3 bar. Paper fills at Monday opens do not show what limit orders would achieve.
tracks.verdictRule: Judged on a version filled at the next Monday open: pass if its return is at least the Bitcoin fund's and its worst drawdown is no worse, with at least 10 position changes. Otherwise inconclusive.

trackNote: The rule state is a dated log of what each rule said, kept to test the rule. It is not a signal and not a suggestion to trade. The BTC40 row shows the locked seed, recorded while that week was still open; a different data feed shows a closed-bar close of 78,354 and average of 72,337 for the same week, with the same state. The two sources are not yet reconciled and the original row is not being changed. Rows are added by hand each Monday.

graveyard.name: Gate stack G1+G2+G3 (gates 1 to 3 only)
graveyard.numbers: Hit-rate ratio 1.036 (95% range 0.979 to 1.085). Average-R difference -0.028 (95% range -0.056 to +0.001), where R is profit as a multiple of the amount risked.
graveyard.read: Did not clear its pass conditions against matched random stock-days after costs. This is why the app teaches the reasoning and makes no promise.
graveyard.check: Cross-checked against the local report on 2026-11-06.

graveyard.name: Buy the RSI dip
graveyard.numbers: Raw trades averaged +1.58%, but lift over matched random volatile days was about zero (99% range -1.07% to +1.06%).
graveyard.read: The test did not show the signal added anything beyond what matched controls earned.
graveyard.check: Cross-checked against the local output file on 2026-11-06.

graveyard.name: Trade analyst rating changes faster than the market
graveyard.numbers: Lift after the assumed 0.5% cost was -0.41% (99% range -0.72% to -0.11%) on 108 events. Before cost the lift was about +0.09%.
graveyard.read: The gross lift was too small to cover the assumed cost.
graveyard.check: Cross-checked against the local summary on 2026-11-06.

graveyard.name: Sector rotation: trade the second move
graveyard.numbers: Lift after cost -0.26% (99% range -0.63% to +0.10%) on 154 events.
graveyard.read: In this sample the range rules out lifts above about +0.10% per trade. The bar was +1.0%.
graveyard.check: Figures re-read against the project result record on 2026-11-06 by its original author (Claude); not an independent check.

graveyard.name: State-based exit table (when to hold or sell)
graveyard.numbers: Lift -0.44% (99% range -1.12% to +0.28%). Shuffled labels scored -0.41%.
graveyard.read: No useful lift was shown under this test. Plain holding beat the cleverer exits here.
graveyard.check: Cross-checked against the local report on 2026-11-06.

graveyard.name: Buy after a sharp one-day drop on heavy volume
graveyard.numbers: Mean net excess return -2.09% per 20 sessions (99% range -3.36% to -0.77%) on 2,422 events. 0 of 11 years positive.
graveyard.read: These stocks went on to trail the market after costs in this sample.
graveyard.check: Verified against the trial ledger on 2026-11-06.

graveyard.read: An earlier positive result came from picking the highest-volume markets. A fresh sample erased it.

graveyard.name: Trend-following sleeve
graveyard.numbers: Max drawdown -3.8% vs -25.1% for 60/40, but the blend beat 60/40 on risk-adjusted return in only 54% of resamples (needed 80%).
graveyard.read: It cut risk, as trend rules do, without a demonstrated gain in risk-adjusted return.

graveyard.name: Bitcoin 30-week trend filter (defensive)
graveyard.numbers: Full-sample drawdown cut was 28% against a required 40%. The last 104 weeks passed.
graveyard.read: Those last 104 weeks are a slice of the same price series, not a sealed data set, and are not one of the four hold-out openings counted above. One down-cycle does not rescue a miss on the full sample.
graveyard.check: Figures re-read against the project result record on 2026-11-06 by its original author (Claude); not an independent check.

graveyard.name: Bitcoin trend filter, four window lengths
graveyard.numbers: 0 of 4 windows passed. The closest missed the drawdown bar (ratio 0.63 to 0.64 against a 0.60 limit).
graveyard.read: The bar was not loosened. The closest variant became BTC40 above, as a forward test, after these results were seen.
graveyard.check: Figures re-read against the project result record on 2026-11-06 by its original author (Claude); not an independent check.

graveyard.name: Odd-lot tender offers
graveyard.numbers: About 1.6 takeable deals a year against a bar of 6.
graveyard.read: A scarcity screen, not a return test: the mechanism is real, but too few usable deals. Most fund tenders deny odd-lot priority.
graveyard.check: Figures re-read against the project result record on 2026-11-06 by its original author (Claude); not an independent check.

graveyard.name: Closed-end fund tender at 98% of NAV (BMEZ, Nov 2026)
graveyard.numbers: About +0.9% blended on a full position at an assumed 50% participation (a figure from a public note), against roughly 3% routine price swings.
graveyard.read: A descriptive feasibility estimate, not measured performance and not a research verdict. Real mechanism, but small and too rare to test.
graveyard.source: BMEZ tender offer filing (SEC, Oct 2026); public commentary.
graveyard.check: Estimate only; not a measured result.

That is a planning screen, not proof the filter does nothing. Parked; reopening needs a new preregistration. Result file SHA-256 0BB6ECCD4C9EDD162B481E98ABA00085321510BD35F242E9DB3BE59F9EF1FDEB.
Iowa tax-sale certificates (TAX1): on hold; no research verdict. The Stage 0 desk audit needs county redemption records that may require treasurer calls, and it has not been run.
SPAC common-share redemption: parked. The effort per expected result was too high.
Bank mutual-to-stock conversions: closed as a system. Eligibility is depositor-based.
lessons: Picking markets by volume manufactured a pattern that a fresh sample erased.
A placebo that is not matched to the trade can pass pure noise. Ours is matched, and was tested on synthetic noise first.
A control definition once added about 0.35% of fake lift under pure noise. A null test caught it before any real data was used.
